en.heroIntro: I am Yiran Rex Ma — artist, engineer, human. I am a Ph.D. student in Theoretical and Applied Linguistics at Peking University, with the PKU & ByteDance Digital Humanities Open Lab (PKUDH) at the Institute for Artificial Intelligence, advised by Prof. Qi Su and concentrating on foundation language models. I am striding towards becoming an LLM engineer, focusing on continual learning and personal models that swiftly adapt the foundation to diverse domains and align with inherent human preferences.

highlights.title: At a Glance
highlights.focusValue: Continual learning & personal models for LLMs

zh.heroIntro: 我是马义然（Yiran Rex Ma）——artist, engineer, human。我是北京大学理论语言学与应用语言学博士研究生，在北京大学人工智能学院北大·字节跳动数字人文开放实验室（PKUDH）师从苏祺教授，研究方向为基础语言模型。我正努力成为一名 LLM 工程师，关注持续学习与个人模型：让基础模型快速适配多样的垂直领域，并实现对人类内在偏好的真正对齐。

highlights.title: 工作速览
highlights.focusValue: 大语言模型的持续学习与个人模型
